settings.ceo_bio:
DADO is more than porcelain stoneware — it is a combination of quality, design and trust. We approach every product with a focus on long-term value.

Our goal is to offer our customers not only beautiful, but also reliable and contemporary solutions. We continue to develop DADO with a strong commitment to quality and responsibility.
settings.ceo_bio_uz:
DADO — bu shunchaki keramogranit emas, bu sifat, dizayn va ishonch uyg‘unligidir. Biz har bir mahsulotga uzoq muddatli qiymat yaratish nuqtayi nazaridan yondashamiz.

Maqsadimiz — mijozlarimizga nafaqat chiroyli, balki ishonchli va zamonaviy yechimlarni taqdim etish. Biz DADO brendini sifat va mas’uliyat bilan rivojlantirishda davom etamiz.
settings.ceo_bio_ru:
DADO — это не просто керамогранит, а сочетание качества, дизайна и доверия. Мы подходим к каждому продукту с пониманием его долгосрочной ценности.

Наша цель — предлагать клиентам не только красивые, но и надёжные современные решения. Мы продолжаем развивать DADO, сохраняя высокие требования к качеству и ответственности.

history.title: Badr Premium Ceramics is founded
history.text:
Our story began in 2020 with the founding of Badr Premium Ceramics. From the very start we chose the field in which we wanted to grow professionally: porcelain stoneware.

We started by importing from China and Iran, studying the market and our customers’ needs, and shaping our own approach to the range. What mattered to us was not simply bringing in products, but finding the right solutions and building long-term relationships with partners.

history.title: New horizons
history.text:
The next milestone came in 2022. We began working with manufacturers in India, broadening both our sourcing geography and our range. Greanza and Varmora became our partners.

This stage took the company to a new level: we immersed ourselves ever more deeply in the global porcelain stoneware industry and expanded what we could offer our customers.

history.title: The birth of Roma Ceramics
history.text:
In 2024, together with Jompeng, we founded Roma Ceramics.

It was an important step from simple importing towards developing our own brands and lines. Roma Ceramics became part of our path to a stronger, more diverse collection of porcelain stoneware solutions.

history.title: Expanding the portfolio
history.text:
In 2026 our story continued to unfold. We launched new lines — Seven Ceramics, Torra Tiles and Crown Ceramics — and broadened the portfolio of brands we represent.

Each brand has its own direction, character and range, yet all share one goal: to offer high-quality, contemporary porcelain stoneware for a wide range of projects.

history.title: Dado: the space that brings it all together
history.text:
Today the next stage of our growth is Dado. Dado is not a separate porcelain stoneware brand but a space that brings together our brands and collections. Seven Ceramics, Torra Tiles, Crown Ceramics, ROMA Ceramics and other solutions are presented here, so customers can choose porcelain stoneware in one place — from the idea and the choice of collection to the finished project.

In just a few years we have come from our first import shipments to a portfolio of our own brands and the modern Dado space. We keep growing, opening new lines and building long-term relationships with customers and partners.

values.title: Who we are
values.text: DADO is a modern porcelain stoneware company that brings together quality, design and trust. We offer solutions for different styles and needs, continuously developing our range and supplying products to the Uzbekistan and international markets.

values.title: Our goal
values.text: Our goal is to offer high-quality, modern and reliable porcelain stoneware solutions, make the choice easier for our customers and develop DADO as a brand people can trust.

values.title: Our mission
values.text: Our mission is to combine quality, modern design and technology to help create beautiful, functional and long-lasting spaces. We strive to be a reliable partner for every customer and help find solutions that match their needs and style.
